target.title: Invoke Plan successor architecture
target.objective: Design the canonical JSON-first Plan source, deterministic generated views, exact admission boundary, and complete readiness and execution consumer contracts without revising the admitted definitions.

constraints.statement: Design must bind the exact admitted Define v4 stage and admission and must not revise its meanings.
Design evidence must use the four pinned Distill v1 schemas and must not consume concurrent Distill v2 material.
Design outputs may describe implementation work but cannot select, accept, execute, publish, or deploy it.

invariants.statement: Exactly one canonical JSON Plan source owns meaning; every Markdown coordinator artifact is derived.
Compilation is deterministic, writes only to absent outputs, and admission independently replays and byte-compares the bundle.
A new Plan PASS requires current evidence from every declared readiness, task, context, dispatch, goal, and observation consumer.

authored_concerns.rationale: The successor changes which artifact owns Plan meaning and must preserve the owner decision and authority ceiling.
No authentication, authorization transport, credential, or security boundary is introduced by this local authoring contract.
Plan tasks, waves, gates, blockers, and terminal handoff states require explicit transition rules.
The compiler and admission steps create exact absent outputs and must define writer ownership and collision behavior.
Blocked prerequisites and failed validation must stop before implementation authority is inferred.
The source-to-view chain must replay deterministically and expose stale or incomplete consumer evidence.
The Design must close the interfaces to readiness, task execution, context, dispatch, goal, and observation consumers.
The successor must replace Work-Pack-as-source wording without rewriting historical artifacts or hiding the compatibility boundary.
This Design authors local governed artifacts and performs no runtime activation, publication, deployment, or release.
The bounded source contains repository planning evidence and introduces no personal-data collection or retention sink.
No runtime latency or throughput claim is made; deterministic correctness is the required quality property.
The generated Markdown is a coordinator view with no new interactive surface or changed human navigation contract.
Every source, generated view, predecessor binding, and downstream readiness claim requires machine validation.

writers.concurrency: Absent outputs only; refuse overwrite or concurrent publication.

normative_rules.subject: Plan successor
normative_rules.object: one canonical JSON source as the sole meaning-bearing Plan source
normative_rules.enforcement_hint: Reject generated views or lifecycle receipts as authored source fields.

normative_rules.subject: Plan handoff
normative_rules.object: typed blockers, gates, and one selected execution-entry boundary
normative_rules.enforcement_hint: Block execution when required readiness evidence is absent or stale.

normative_rules.subject: Plan admission
normative_rules.object: every declared readiness and execution consumer
normative_rules.enforcement_hint: Run the exact consumer contracts against the staged bundle before PASS.

compatibility_boundaries.old_contract: stored WORK-PACK.md is described as the Plan source of truth
compatibility_boundaries.new_contract: stored canonical JSON Plan source owns meaning and WORK-PACK.md is generated
